page.title: Matter
page.subtitle: Connection to the Matter sidecar.
page.insecureText: The sidecar is reached over plain http on a non-loopback address. The token travels unencrypted. Use https, or keep the sidecar on the same host.

status.title: Connection status
status.loadError: The status could not be loaded.

hint.not_configured: Enter the sidecar URL and token below to connect.
hint.connected: The plugin is connected to the Matter sidecar.
hint.unavailable: The sidecar cannot be reached. Check that it is running and that the URL, port and firewall are correct. Attraccess retries automatically.
hint.unauthorized: The sidecar rejected the token. Check the token (also after a rotation) and enter it again.
hint.incompatible: The versions do not match. Upgrade or downgrade Attraccess, the Matter plugin or the sidecar to the supported combination shown below.
hint.misconfigured: The URL, the CA certificate or the TLS setup is invalid. Check the URL and path prefix, and that the CA matches the sidecar certificate.
hint.hostVersion: This Attraccess version does not report its version. Upgrade Attraccess to {{attraccess}} or newer.

form.title: Connection settings
form.urlDescription: Use https for anything but the same host. A path prefix for a reverse proxy is allowed.
form.credentialDescription: The shared service token configured on the sidecar. It is never shown again after saving.
form.caDescription: PEM certificate(s) of a private CA. They are trusted in addition to Node.js's default root certificates, not instead of them.
form.caCleared: The CA certificate will be removed when you save.
form.savedText: The connection settings were saved. The plugin reconnects now.
form.removeText: The URL and token are deleted and the plugin disconnects from the sidecar.
form.loadError: The connection settings could not be loaded.

fabric.title: Fabric & backup
fabric.loadError: The fabric status could not be loaded.
fabric.unreachableText: The fabric state is unknown until the plugin is connected to the sidecar.
fabric.recoveryRequired: The fabric does not match this installation

storageReason.storage_unreadable: The sidecar cannot read its storage.
storageReason.schema_mismatch: The sidecar's storage has a different schema version.
storageReason.metadata_missing: The sidecar's storage metadata is missing.
storageReason.metadata_orphaned: The sidecar's storage metadata has no fabric data.

mismatch.unknown: The sidecar's fabric differs from what Attraccess recorded.
mismatch.sidecar_uninitialized: Attraccess knows a fabric, but the sidecar has none. Its storage was probably lost or replaced.
mismatch.fabric_changed: The sidecar runs a different fabric than the one Attraccess recorded.
mismatch.generation_behind: The sidecar's fabric is older than what Attraccess recorded. Its storage was probably restored from an old copy.
mismatch.generation_ahead: The sidecar's fabric is newer than what Attraccess recorded. The sidecar changed without Attraccess.
mismatch.storage_instance_changed: The sidecar's storage is a different instance than the one Attraccess recorded.
mismatch.sidecar_recovery_required: The sidecar reports that it needs recovery.

fabric.uninitializedText: The sidecar has no fabric yet. Create it to start commissioning devices.
fabric.createHint: Creates the Matter fabric on the sidecar, a recovery key and the first backup.
fabric.restoreInstead: Do you already have a backup of a Matter fabric, for example after reinstalling? Restore it instead of creating a new fabric, so devices stay controllable.
fabric.createError: The fabric could not be created

key.title: Your recovery key
key.warning: This key decrypts your backups. Without it, a backup cannot be restored. Attraccess cannot show it again. Store it somewhere safe, apart from the backups.
key.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the key and copy it manually.
key.fileHeader: Attraccess Matter recovery key. Keep it secret and safe.
key.acknowledge: I have stored the recovery key in a safe place.
key.missingText: Backups are encrypted with a recovery key. Generate one to enable backups.
key.generateError: The recovery key could not be generated
key.unacknowledgedText: A recovery key was generated, but you did not confirm that you stored it. It cannot be shown again. Rotate it to get a new one.
key.rotateText: A new key encrypts future backups. Existing backups still need the old key, so keep it until they are replaced. The new key is shown once.
key.rotateError: The recovery key could not be rotated

backups.title: Backups

reason.inconsistent: The sidecar and the plugin disagree about the fabric, so no consistent backup can be made.
reason.sidecar_unavailable: The Matter sidecar could not be reached.
reason.sidecar_busy: The Matter sidecar is busy with another backup or restore. Try again shortly.
reason.insecure_transport: Backups are refused over a plain HTTP connection to a remote sidecar. Use https or a local connection.
reason.no_recovery_key: There is no recovery key yet.
reason.recovery_key_unreadable: The stored recovery key cannot be read by this installation.
reason.recovery_required: The fabric needs recovery first. No backup is made in this state.
reason.no_fabric: There is no fabric to back up.
reason.sidecar_error: The Matter sidecar could not produce a snapshot.
reason.internal: The backup failed because of an internal error.

backups.downloadError: The backup could not be downloaded
backups.retention: The latest {{count}} backups are kept. Backup files are encrypted and need the recovery key to restore.

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.intro: Validate a backup first. Nothing changes until you confirm.
restore.recoveryKeyHint: The key this backup was encrypted with.

error.empty: The file is empty. Choose the backup file you downloaded.
error.tooLarge: The file is too large to upload here (at most 7 MB). Restore from a stored backup instead.
error.key_required: This backup was encrypted with a different recovery key. Enter that recovery key.
error.wrong_key: The recovery key is wrong. Check it and try again.
error.corrupt: The backup is corrupt or has been modified and cannot be used.
error.truncated: The backup is incomplete, probably because the file was cut off. Download it again.
error.incompatible_format: This file is not a backup in a supported format.
error.incompatible_schema: The backup uses a storage schema version that this installation cannot restore.
error.incompatible_migration: The backup was made with a different plugin database version. Install the plugin version that created it.
error.incompatible_version: The plugin version must match the version that created the backup. Install that version first.
error.stage_failed: The sidecar could not prepare the backup. Your installation was left unchanged.
error.insecure_transport: Restoring needs a secure connection to the sidecar. Use https or a local sidecar.
error.sidecar_unavailable: The sidecar cannot be reached. Try again when it is connected.
error.confirmation_required: Type the fabric ID to confirm.

kind.rollback: Roll back to an earlier state

restore.previewHint: The backup is valid. Restoring replaces the fabric and the plugin's Matter data with the backup.
restore.previewHintBackup: A backup of the current state is taken first.
restore.overwriteText: The sidecar currently runs a healthy fabric. Restoring replaces it. Devices commissioned after the backup was made will be lost and must be commissioned again.
restore.typeFabricId: Type the current fabric ID {{fabricId}} to confirm
restore.running: Restoring. Do not close this page.
restore.successText: The fabric and the plugin data were restored and verified.

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.blockedText: Until you choose how to recover, creating a fabric and other fabric changes are blocked. Nothing is changed automatically.
recovery.restoreText: Bring back the fabric and data from a stored or uploaded backup.
recovery.acceptText: Treat the fabric the sidecar runs now as the correct one.
recovery.acceptUnavailable: Only available while the sidecar runs a healthy fabric.
recovery.acceptConfirmText: Attraccess will treat the sidecar's current fabric as authoritative and forget what it recorded before. Devices tied to the old fabric are no longer controllable.
recovery.newUnavailable: Only available while the sidecar has no fabric.
recovery.newConfirmText: Every device commissioned before must be factory-reset and commissioned again, because it belongs to the old fabric. This cannot be undone.
